conclusion: 034 endpoint failure has two observable layers: its deterministic A alone has much worse hard-window waveform energy, and final random heads create large charge/local variability plus boundary/rail failures through strong endpoint feature interaction. This is not a global feature-RMS explosion. Carrier energy improves sharply while waveform energy deteriorates, but total original energy also rises, so the carrier term is a plausible competing auxiliary influence rather than an established sole cause. The single next repair trial is carrier training weight .25 to0 with every other034 scientific setting fixed.

source_mechanisms.model029: Lines75-107: A amplitude multiplies projectedB and local envelope; decoded drives basis/envelope; pooled plus SOURCE scalars drivesv; charge log variance is squaredv norm. Gaussian tails and softplus envelope are unbounded.
source_mechanisms.model008: Lines187-217: trainable mean residual .20*tanh, filter and time warp enter raw_shape, then divide by positive canonical shape charge before multiplying qbar. No saved evidence here proves a near-zero normalization denominator.
source_mechanisms.observation008: Lines50-65 and89-102: hard first argmax yields nondifferentiable crop indices; selected values keep gather gradient. ADC STE changes backward only. Peak-normalized wave views add max/division sensitivity.
source_mechanisms.energy031: Lines71-88: same original ADC observation supplies raw-carrier and cropped/normalized views. Proper marginal energy does not supply conditional labels or guarantee optimizer convergence.
source_mechanisms.limits: No gradient, finite-difference or optimizer replay was executed in035, so neither STE bias nor a particular loss component gradient is measured by these endpoint effects.

single_recommendation.decision: One bounded actual036 repair trial, carrier training weight .25 to0 only.
single_recommendation.formula: L036=mean_H(wave_energy+2*joint_signed_integral_energy)+.01*(model_regular+pre_ADC_saturation). Keep carrier energy and original L032/034 data/objective as report-only scalars from the same observations/parts.
single_recommendation.rationale: The carrier auxiliary exhibits a directly measured competing endpoint direction and is not the primary registered waveform readout. Removing it is a one-factor objective intervention; it does not assume feature magnitude failure, freeze the mean, reduce every LR or invent event labels.
single_recommendation.fixed: Rebuild original034 initial mean from originalA and frozen005, same seed2026101732, all M/R trainable, AdamW mean1e-4/shape1.875e-5/charge+local3e-4, clip5,2000steps, independent IID TRAIN banks, three H, same evaluation population/RNG/nativeW1/T/flags and DEV-after-freeze once.
single_recommendation.tradeoff: Removing carrier drops direct training pressure on raw trigger position and waveform tail outside the256 readout. Full256 voltage energy still provides a proper marginal observed-waveform target, but no conditional or complete pre-ADC carrier identification follows. Preserve report-only carrier and all native support/rail/PSD/shape gates to expose that cost.
single_recommendation.success: Original pilot progress criterion only: TRAIN native wave gain>=2percent againstA in all3H, and every defined positive-calibrated component delta<=T on bothTRAIN andDEV. Report absoluteT andRR separately;2percent is progress, not well-fit/physical-response acceptance.
single_recommendation.stop: One fixed endpoint. If any original gate fails, close036 negative; no automatic LR alternative, weight grid, extra steps or best-checkpoint selection. Even success does not identify conditional response or low-count extrapolation.
single_recommendation.minimal_alternative_not_selected: Hard-risk backtracking/acceptance could constrain non-descent, but it also changes optimizer state acceptance, adaptive bank reuse and compute budget. The saved data do not justify introducing that second mechanism before this one-factor objective trial.
single_recommendation.uncertainty: The original objective also scores final worse, so carrier traction is not proven to be the sole failure mechanism and the proposed trial is not promised to fit.
